snippet.description:
UPSC Preparation Strategy: Why You Must Prepare for Mains Before Prelims | UPSC CSE 2027 & 2028

Should you prepare for UPSC Prelims first and start Mains preparation only after the exam? This approach can put you at a disadvantage.

For UPSC CSE 2027 and 2028 aspirants, the key is to integrate Mains preparation into your overall study plan instead of treating Prelims, Mains and the Interview as completely separate phases.

In this video, we discuss why you should prepare with the mindset that you will write Mains, continue building your Mains readiness alongside Prelims preparation, and avoid relying entirely on the limited time between Prelims and Mains.

Remember: Your UPSC preparation should be integrated from the beginning, not postponed until after Prelims.
